main_text.p: quoque modum, & propter eafdem cauffas, manducatio panis visibilis, in nouo testamento, κατὰ τὸ πνευμα & corporaliter, inuisibilis autem panis, nimirum Christi, manducatio, figurate fit & spiritualiter accipienda.
main_text.head: Quaeritur itaque;
main_text.p: An manducatio carnis Christi, siue in vetere, siue in Nouo Testamento, ideo literaliter seu κατὰ τὸ πνευμα & corporaliter fit intelligenda, quia in vetere testamento Manducationem Agni, in nouo Manducationem panis, iuxta τὸ πνευμα & corporaliter intelligi oporteat? Vel, An ideo adsperfio sanguinis Christi in vetere vel nouo Testamento, necessario fit iuxta τὸ πνευμα & corporaliter intelligenda, quod Adsperfionem sanguinis taurorum & hircorum in vetere, & Adsperfionem aquae Baptismi in nouo Testamento, iuxta τὸ πνευμα & corporaliter intelligi oporteat?
main_text.head: Quaestio IIII.
main_text.p: Ac quia Parabolae & similitudines, quibus Christus vtitur, ita explicantur, vt figurate eas accipi oporteat, anne etiam hancipsam ob causam directum ac perspicuum & expressum Christi in nouo testamento praeceptum & mandatum, figuratiue & aliter, quam Coenae Domini verba sonant, intelligendum sit & interpretandum?

page.notes: Greek words in the text were transcribed approximately; the Greek phrases (κατὰ τὸ πνευμα) are uncertain readings. Catchword absent.
